Pick who this phone belongs to first.
Paste the device token from the sign-in page.
Your name, as they\'ll see it
Not needed on this Android version.

Sign in, paste the token it gives you, then save. Allow exact alarms so the widget refreshes on time, and set Battery to Unrestricted so Android does not stop it in the background. Add the widget from your home screen and tap the name to switch between the two of you.
